welcome.title: Welcome to Ignis Vision
welcome.body: Ignis Vision supports fire response with AI analysis of building zones and thermal imagery. This short tour shows the parts you will use.

disclaimer.title: Decision support, not a guarantee
disclaimer.body: Always apply your training and judgement. A zone shown as safe is only as current as its last analysis, and a missing detection does not guarantee nobody is present.

live.title: Live monitoring
live.body: Log an emergency, assign responders to zones and watch the zone risk map, alerts and the ranked list of people detected update in real time.

capture.title: Zone capture
capture.body: Point your phone's rear camera at a zone and press Start. The server classifies the zone as safe, caution, unsafe or blocked and speaks critical alerts.

analysis.title: Thermal and image analysis
analysis.body: Upload thermal images or videos. People are detected, their posture is classified and they are ranked by the Rescue Priority Index.

reports.title: Incident records
reports.body: Closed incidents keep a full timeline, zone history and victim list, and can be exported as a PDF in English or Urdu.

trainer.title: Simulation trainer
trainer.body: Practise classifying zones and postures on real incident media, then compare your answers with the reference answer and the model's output.

admin.title: Administration
admin.body: Manage user accounts and roles, training scenarios and system settings. Every change you make is recorded in the audit log.

controls.title: Always within reach
controls.body: The top bar has the language switch, the connection indicator and the ? button, which opens help for the screen you are on. You can replay this tour from Settings.

getting-started.title: Getting started
getting-started.body: Sign in with the username and password from your administrator. Choose English or Urdu; you can switch any time with the language button in the top bar. The ? button on every screen opens help for that screen.

live.title: Live monitoring
live.body: Shows the active incident: key figures, the zone risk map, real-time alerts and people detected, ranked by priority. Zones without a current analysis are shown as unclassified, never as safe.

capture.title: Zone capture
capture.body: Choose the incident and zone, then press Start. Keep the rear camera pointed at the zone. The result appears as a large status label and critical changes are spoken aloud. The camera needs a secure (HTTPS) connection and permission.

analysis.title: Thermal & image analysis
analysis.body: Drop a thermal image or video, tag it to an incident and zone, and wait for the analysis. Each person is shown with a box, posture label, priority band and confidence. Low-confidence postures are flagged.

reports.title: Incident reports
reports.body: Lists past incidents with filters. Open one to see its timeline, zone history, people detected and media, and download the PDF report in English or Urdu.

team.title: Team deployment
team.body: Assign field responders to zones and reassign them during an incident. The full assignment history is kept.

trainer.title: Simulation trainer
trainer.body: Pick a scenario, label each zone region and each person's posture, then submit. You will see your answer next to the reference answer and the model's output, with a score. You can retry any scenario.

admin.title: Administration
admin.body: Create and deactivate accounts, reset passwords, manage training scenarios, tune system settings and review the audit log. Every change is recorded.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Choose your language, turn spoken alerts and alert sounds on or off, change your password and replay the getting-started tour.

set.tuneNote: These defaults are starting points. Tune them with Rescue 1122 before operational use; every change is audited.

secHint.rpi: RPI = weighted posture, detection confidence and zone risk. Bands map the score to Critical / High / Medium / Low.
secHint.fusion: Shares and confidences (0–1) that turn segmentation and damage detections into Safe / Caution / Unsafe / Blocked.
secHint.timing: How long a zone status stays current, alert windows, the capture rate and the evacuation threshold.
secHint.data: Incidents and media older than this are deleted automatically. Keep forever = never delete.
secHint.ai: Need LLM_PROVIDER and LLM_API_KEY in the server's .env. Alerts, zone status and RPI never use AI.
secHint.trainer: Optional half credit when a zone answer is one step away from the correct one (e.g. caution vs unsafe).

grading.partial_credit_adjacent: Partial credit for adjacent zone status

features.report_narrative: Rewrites the report summary from the recorded facts.
features.trainer_feedback: Explains a trainee's mistakes after submitting.
features.help_assistant: Answers questions on help pages, using only the help text.

grading.partial_credit_adjacent: Applies to zone answers only, never to postures.

err.bands: Bands must be critical > high > medium.
err.weights: At least one weight must be above 0.
